# Kaze AI

> > Kaze AI is a comprehensive AI-powered image and video editing platform offering free tools for photo enhancement, virtual try-on, background removal, and creative transformations.

Kaze AI provides both free web-based editing tools and enterprise API solutions for image processing. The platform specializes in AI-driven features like watermark removal, clothing visualization, photo restoration, and advanced image enhancement.

## Key Topics

- AI Image Editor
- Photo Editing
- Virtual Try-On
- Watermark Removal
- Image Enhancement
- Background Removal
- Photo Restoration
- AI Video Generation
- Image Upscaling
- Free Online Tools
- Enterprise API
- Fashion Visualization

- Seedance 2.0

## Core Tools & Features

- [All Tools](https://kaze.ai/all-tools): Comprehensive showcase of Kaze AI's photo editing tools and features
- [Image Upscaler](https://kaze.ai/image-upscaler): Free AI image upscaler for enlarging low-resolution photos to HD
- [Image Enhancer](https://kaze.ai/image-enhancer): Free AI photo enhancement and upscaling for improved image quality
- [Unblur Image](https://kaze.ai/unblur-image): Free AI tool to unblur and sharpen photos with detail restoration
- [PNG Maker](https://kaze.ai/png-maker): Free background removal tool for creating transparent PNG images
- [AI Image Expand](https://kaze.ai/ai-expand): AI image expansion and uncropping tool for content creation
- [Photo Restoration](https://kaze.ai/photo-restoration): AI-powered old photo restoration with colorization and repair features
- [Face Cut Out](https://kaze.ai/ai-face-cut-out): Free AI face extraction and background removal tool for photo editing

## Virtual Try-On & Fashion Tools

- [AI Clothes Changer](https://kaze.ai/ai-clothes-changer): AI-powered virtual try-on tool for outfit transformation and fashion
- [AI Dress Changer](https://kaze.ai/ai-dress): Virtual dress try-on tool for fashion visualization and e-commerce
- [AI Wedding Dress](https://kaze.ai/ai-wedding-dress): AI wedding dress visualizer for bridal try-on and custom gown design
- [Add Suit to Photo](https://kaze.ai/ai-add-suit-to-photo-online-free): Add formal suits to photos for professional headshots and LinkedIn profiles

## AI Video & Creative Filters

- [Seedance 2.0](https://kaze.ai/ai-seedance2.0): Next-gen AI video generation with text-to-video and motion stability
- [Goth AI Filter](https://kaze.ai/ai-goth-ai): Free AI-powered Goth filter for gothic aesthetic photo transformation
